name: Judicator
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: oleonardosilva
description: Judicator is a powerful and flexible moderation plugin built for Minecraft servers. It provides a complete set of tools for managing player behavior with permanent and temporary punishments, IP-based actions, and administrative utilities.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
